title: •Ki-Adi-Mundi
caption: •Ki-Adi-Mundi (V)
game_text: While Maul present, Ki-Adi-Mundi is Heroic. Obi-Wan’s Cape, Obi-Wan’s Journal, and {ovs:9} Jedi Lightsaber may deploy on Ki-Adi-Mundi. Once per game, may exchange two cards from hand with any one card in Lost Pile.
lore: Cerean Jedi trained by Yoda since the age of four. Only *Jedi Council member* who is a Jedi Knight. Freed his homeworld from a group of rogues without any bloodshed.
copyright: © 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 5 / ABILITY 6 / JEDI KNIGHT (label only); deploy 6 / forfeit 5 (printed 5/6); the wiki stub has deploy=5 (differs). Icon column: warrior. Republic (Coruscant silver frame, Republic crest disc; the printed card has the Coruscant ring AND an Episode I icon beside the lore box). Inline blue-purple sphere before 'Jedi Lightsaber' = the Original Virtual Set 9 sphere (matches assets/icons/ovs-set-9.png; stub: 'Virtual Set 9 Jedi Lightsaber') → {ovs:9}. Curly apostrophes in Obi-Wan’s (twice). Margin credits printed vertically on two lines each. Lore corrected from scan: 'Jedi Council member' is BOLD (visible on the scan and the VB5 remake). Base scan 357 px only; copyright Coruscant 2001 SE-style form, partly legible.
